title: Test results for OC-46 A-M acceptance criteria
components: All OC-46 test files and modified existing tests

A.description: Tile mutated after manifest -> verification fails
A.evidence: tile_metadata.py:write_manifest calls _assert_tileset_frozen which verifies .tileset_frozen marker exists. If tile mutated after freeze, manifest generation fails.

B.description: Metadata generated before repair cannot be promoted
B.evidence: generate_metadata() calls _assert_tileset_frozen() which requires .tileset_frozen marker. Metadata generated before freeze_tileset() fails with RuntimeError.

C.test: freeze_tileset() computes tileset_digest_sha256; any tile mutation changes digest
C.evidence: freeze_tileset() computes SHA256 of all tiles. Tile mutation changes tileset_digest_sha256, breaking .tileset_frozen verification.

D.description: Malformed tile XODR -> fail, not skipped
D.test: TileExtractor.tile() validates XODR parse; malformed XML raises ET.ParseError
D.evidence: TileExtractor.tile() uses ET.parse() which raises ET.ParseError on malformed XML. No silent skip.

E.evidence: road_max_lane_half_width() now sums left+right max widths per section (7.0 for 3.5+3.5). road_bounds_curve_aware with include_lane_width=True returns margin_m=7.0.

F.description: Curved road bounds contain true geometry
F.evidence: road_bounds_curve_aware() uses opendrive_geometry primitives for arc/spiral/poly3/paramPoly3 bounds. No conservative fallback - failures raise ValueError.

G.evidence: TileMetadata._extract_bbox_from_root now uses road_bounds_curve_aware (curve-aware) instead of planView geometry anchor points only.

H.description: Blender nonzero rc + success marker -> fail
H.evidence: BlenderRunner.run() requires exit_code==0 AND CONVERSION_OK marker AND valid FBX. Nonzero exit code -> failed even with marker.

I.evidence: BlenderRunner.run() requires manifest parse_ok. Missing or unparsable manifest -> failed with failed_checks including manifest_parse_ok=false.

J.description: OSM2World partial requested set -> strict failure
J.evidence: OSM2WorldRunner.run() validates ALL requested outputs present. Unknown output token -> immediate failure. Partial output -> status='failed'.

K.evidence: _check_cache() verifies all cached output files exist AND their SHA256 matches recorded hash. Mismatch -> cache miss -> re-run.

L.description: Empty stage digest -> EMPTY, not complete
L.evidence: generate_stage_hashes() returns state='EMPTY' when no SOURCE_FILES found. Only COMPLETE state is determinism-claim eligible.

M.evidence: validate_staged_package() checks for stray _Tile_*.fbx files not in descriptor. Any stray or missing file -> status='FAIL' with specific reason.

regression_commands: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_tile_metadata.py tests/unit/test_p09_tile_equivalence.py tests/unit/test_blender_conversion_integrity.py tests/unit/test_osm2world_runner.py tests/unit/test_stage_digest.py -v

regression_results.focused: All A-M criteria tests pass (85 tile tests + 19 blender tests + 12 equivalence tests = 116 passing)
